items.rationale: Sections 4.2.2 and 7.1.9–7.1.10 allow like-for-like replacement of a fixed unit damaged beyond repair, with no kitchen-location exclusion in this wording. The €1,413 gross estimate assumes the fire group was selected and the surge was caused by lightning or other atmospheric electricity under §2.3.3; neither is confirmed.

Under §§7.1.11 and 9.5, labour to install a covered replacement follows the unit, but any unrelated wiring check must be separated. Allow €480 gross for one standard installation if the underlying loss is covered.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.9–7.1.10 allow €61 gross for an equivalent console if the original was damaged or replacement was necessary to reinstate the covered unit. The description confirms a pre-loss console but does not show that it was damaged or could not be reused.

Under §7.1.11, ordinary freight follows the covered replacement; any share attributable to unrelated equipment must be apportioned out. Allow €43 gross for one standard shipment attributable to the kitchen unit if covered.
